column1: # Source-owned production evidence for the signedness-sensitive DIV/MOD leaf.

column5: Integer DIV dispatch now follows Go's DivInt64/DivUintWithInt/DivIntWithUint helpers, and MOD preserves the source dividend sign plus its left-operand unsigned result flag. Decimal/real, function-class type inference, warning policy, and session SQL-mode paths remain outside the compact Datum evaluator.
